name: Reviewify — Review Discounts & Photo/Video Reviews for WooCommerce
author: Xfinitysoft

sections.description:
Boost WooCommerce reviews with automated discount coupons, allow photo and video uploads for reviews, and send email reminders. Reviewify turns customer feedback into visual social proof and repeat sales – no coding required.

👉 Try the Demo | Documentation | Pro Version | Facebook Page

Reviewify is a next-generation WooCommerce review rewards plugin built to help store owners boost customer engagement, collect high-quality product feedback, and automate reviews for discount campaigns that increase conversions.

With Reviewify, you can:

  • Reward verified buyers for submitting product reviews with WooCommerce review coupons.

  • Let customers upload photos and video reviews for authentic social proof.

  • Send automated review reminder emails using SendGrid WooCommerce integration for perfect deliverability.

  • Display reviews beautifully with custom review filters, average ratings, and helpful review voting options.

No coding. No third-party apps. Just a single, powerful WooCommerce review automation plugin that helps you turn feedback into sales.

🌟 Key Features of Review for Discount Plugin

🛍️ Review Rewards & Discount Campaigns

  • Create smart review discount campaigns to reward customer feedback automatically.

  • Automatically send WooCommerce review coupons or discount codes when a customer submits a single review.

  • Set multiple review discount goals (e.g., after 3 or 5 reviews) to unlock exclusive WooCommerce discounts for loyal customers. (Pro)

  • Target specific products or categories for review-based discounts.

  • Choose percentage, fixed cart, or fixed product discounts and manually set the coupon value.

  • Define review coupons’ validity periods, usage limits, and spending thresholds.

  • Offer free shipping rewards to motivate reviewers.

  • Exclude sale items and enforce individual-use coupons to protect margins.

  • Automatically remove expired coupons created through Reviewify. (Pro)

✉️ Automated Email Marketing

  • Send personalized review request emails after purchase.

  • Customize subject lines and templates with brand tone and visuals.

  • Set photo review reminder emails to collect authentic visual testimonials. (Pro)

  • Use dynamic placeholders like {customer_name} and {product_name} for personalization.

  • Adjust email header color for brand consistency. (Pro)

  • Configure email settings for multiple reviews and close-to-target reminders. (Pro)

  • Preview campaigns with Send Test Email before publishing.

  • Improve deliverability with SendGrid integration for WooCommerce reviews.

🖼️ Photo & Video Reviews (Pro)

  • Allow customers to upload images and videos with their reviews.

  • Limit the number of uploaded files per reviewer for moderation control.

  • Enable review editing and helpful voting to enhance credibility.

  • Display average rating summaries with progress bars for transparency.

  • Protect privacy with the reviewer name masking option.

🎨 Review Display Customization (Pro)

  • Customize star colors, progress bars, and filter designs for on-brand styling.

  • Adjust text and background colors to match your WooCommerce store’s theme.

  • Display average ratings summary with progress bars to instantly showcase product satisfaction.

  • Add advanced review filters (by rating, date, or media) for better navigation.

📊 Analytics & Insights (Pro)

  • View real-time review statistics inside your dashboard.

  • Track total reviews, media uploads, and the number of reviews with media.

  • Analyze engagement trends to improve review conversion and loyalty.

⚙️ WooCommerce Integration

  • 100% native WooCommerce compatibility – no coding required.

  • Works seamlessly with coupons, checkout, and email systems.

  • Fully compatible with popular WordPress themes and builders.

  • Simple zero-code setup directly from your WordPress admin panel.

💡Bonus: All-in-One Review & Reward Automation

Reviewify unifies review collection, discount automation, and email marketing into one lightweight WooCommerce review plugin – designed to increase reviews, boost customer engagement, and drive repeat purchases.

🏆 Why Choose Reviewify?

✅ Reward customers automatically after reviews: Instantly send WooCommerce review coupons or discount rewards to boost engagement and repeat sales.

✅ Collect photo & video testimonials: Get authentic photo reviews and video reviews to increase social proof and conversions.

✅ Smart review discount campaigns: Automate review-based discount campaigns to turn feedback into repeat purchases.

✅ Verified, media-rich reviews: Build trust with verified purchase badges, real images, and videos that enhance SEO credibility.

✅ Branded review emails: Send automated review reminder and thank-you emails using SendGrid integration for better deliverability.

✅ Seamless WooCommerce integration: Fully compatible with WooCommerce products, coupons, and email automation for a smooth experience.

🧰 Use Cases

  • Encourage verified reviews: Reward customers automatically with WooCommerce review coupons after verified purchases.

  • Boost new product launches: Increase review volume and visibility using automated review rewards.

  • Promote photo reviews on social media: Showcase authentic photo and video reviews to grow social proof and engagement.

  • Run seasonal discount campaigns: Launch offers like “Review & Get 10% Off” using review-based discount automation.

  • Recover lost sales: Send post-purchase review reminder emails to reduce cart abandonment and drive repeat orders.

Free vs Pro: A Quick Comparison

Free Version Includes:

✔ Smart review discount campaigns to reward customer feedback automatically.

✔ Automatic coupon generation for single product reviews.

✔ Product & category-specific targeting for review-based rewards.

✔ Flexible discount options—percentage, fixed cart, or product-based.

✔ Custom validity periods, usage limits, and free shipping rewards.

✔ Automated review request emails with dynamic placeholders.

✔ SendGrid integration for reliable WooCommerce review emails.

✔ Seamless WooCommerce compatibility with zero-code setup.

Pro Version Unlocks (everything in Free, plus):

✅ Multiple review goals (e.g., reward after 3 or 5 reviews).

✅ Automated photo and video review system to collect authentic visual testimonials.

✅ Review editing, helpful voting, and reviewer privacy masking for trust and credibility.

✅ Email header customization, multi-review reminders, and close-to-target notifications.

✅ Photo review reminder emails to boost user-generated visual content.

✅ Advanced review display customization – change star colors, progress bars, text, and background styles.

✅ Add smart review filters (by rating, date, or media type) for a better user experience.

✅ Real-time review analytics & insights to monitor engagement and conversion impact.

✅ Automatic deletion of expired review coupons to keep campaigns clean and efficient.

🚀 Compatibility & Integrations

  • WooCommerce 5.0+

  • SendGrid Email API

  • Works perfectly with all popular WooCommerce extensions

  • Compatible with major WordPress page builders and themes (Elementor, Astra, Divi, etc.)

📚 Documentation & Support

Need help? Access our step-by-step documentation and 24/7 support directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Reviewify offers quick setup guides, tutorials, and email support to help you make the most of your WooCommerce review plugin.

sections.installation:
Installation Requirements

To use Reviewify, make sure your site meets these requirements:

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher

  • PHP 7.0 or higher

  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher (required for review and discount automation features)

  • SendGrid account (optional — for smooth email delivery)

How to Install Reviewify

Follow these simple steps to install the plugin:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Go to Plugins → Add Plugin.

  3. Search for “Reviewify — Review Discounts & Photo/Video Reviews for WooCommerce.”

  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.

  5. First, go to Reviewify → Add Review Discount to configure review rewards.

  6. Then, go to WooCommerce → Settings → Reviewify to set up email templates, photo reviews, and automation rules.

  7. Enable review requests, set discount types, and customize your review display, all with just a few clicks.

No coding needed. Reviewify integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce to collect reviews, reward customers, and boost repeat sales automatically.
sections.faq:
How do I reward customers after a review?

Reviewify automatically generates and sends WooCommerce discount coupons after a verified product review. You can customize the coupon type, amount, validity, and trigger rules for single or multiple reviews.

Can I send automated emails using Reviewify?

Yes, Reviewify includes a WooCommerce review email automation system that sends review reminders, thank-you messages, and photo review requests, all fully customizable and SendGrid-compatible.

Does Reviewify support photo and video reviews?

Absolutely. Customers can upload images and videos with their reviews, creating authentic photo and video testimonials that boost social proof and sales.

How can I customize review colors and styles?

You can personalize your review display with custom star colors, text colors, filter backgrounds, and progress bar designs, matching your store’s branding perfectly.

Is it compatible with my WooCommerce theme?

Yes, Reviewify is fully WooCommerce-native and works seamlessly with all major themes, builders, and checkout plugins.

Can I exclude sale items from review discounts?

Yes, you can exclude sale products to prevent overlapping promotions and maintain pricing control in your review discount campaigns.

Does Reviewify support any native SMTP integration?

Yes, Reviewify includes SendGrid SMTP integration for improved email deliverability and branding.

Can I limit how many photos or videos customers upload?

Yes, you can set maximum file upload limits per review to maintain performance and moderation control.

Can customers edit or update their reviews?

Definitely. Reviewify allows review editing, so customers can update their text or media anytime, increasing authenticity and engagement.

Does Reviewify include review analytics?

Yes, you’ll get real-time review analytics, including total reviews, media uploads, and the number of reviews with media.

Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce store?

Not at all. Reviewify is lightweight and performance-optimized, ensuring fast page loads and smooth store operation.
